course.title: Painting & Finishing Basics
course.description: A beginner course introducing painting and finishing work through five selected YouTube lessons. It covers the general learning journey from understanding the task and preparing surfaces to selecting tools, applying coatings, and checking the finished result. Lesson descriptions are curator-written topic guides and must be checked against the actual videos before publication.
learningOutcomes: Understand the general stages of painting and finishing work
Recognize the importance of surface preparation
Become familiar with common tools, materials, and application methods
Identify basic quality checks and finishing considerations

modules.title: Introduction to Painting and Finishing
modules.description: An introductory lesson in painting and finishing. Use the video to understand the scope of the work, the stages involved, and the importance of planning before starting a painting or finishing task.

lessons.title: Introduction to Painting and Finishing

learningObjectives: Describe the main stages of a painting and finishing task

modules.title: Preparing Surfaces for Painting

certificate.disclaimer: This certificate confirms completion of introductory online learning only. It is not a trade licence, accredited qualification, or authorization to perform professional painting work.

course.safetyNotice: Painting and finishing may involve solvents, fumes, dust, ladders, sharp tools, and flammable materials. Ensure suitable ventilation, follow product labels and safety data, use appropriate PPE, keep ignition sources away from flammable products, and seek qualified supervision for hazardous work at height or with specialist coatings.
